jawa-1-lng-power-fishers.why: Every sentence checked out word for word on the ADB eligibility report and the ADB news release, but none of them is a condition. The report says the Safeguard Policy Statement (2009) applied and the project was put in Category A, B and C, which is ADB policy for all its projects. It says a resettlement plan 'was prepared' and that monitoring reports 'are disclosed'; it never says the money depended on any of this. The news release says the project 'will also offer opportunities to improve women's livelihoods through targets for women's employment and training on livelihood and skills development to be monitored by ADB' - a project feature, not a stated condition of the loan. The JBIC page gives the loan size and a general definition of project finance, with no conditions.

phnom-penh-hcmc-highway-nr1.why: The ADB evaluation gives '12 standard loan covenants', the phrase 'fully complied with 7 (58%) of 12 standard loan covenants', partial compliance on resettlement and compensation, environmental mitigation and road maintenance, the tripartite meetings covenant, the $10.7 million the government was to finance and the $7.1 million it provided. Loan covenants are terms of the loan, so the safeguard type stands.

sendou-bargny-coal.changed: Removed the sentences on the AfDB policies, on the later remedial measures and on the IFC Performance Standards. Removed the safeguard type.
sendou-bargny-coal.why: The covenant quote and the missing resettlement plan are on the IRM page as written. The rest does not support a condition: the three AfDB policies are bank-wide policy, the marine study, ash plan and water study are remedial measures ordered years after the harm, and the ICM report says only that the compliance review 'found noncompliances with IFC Performance Standards 1, 3 and 5' - it does not say the financing required those standards, so the safeguard type had nothing to rest on. The surviving sentence records that no environmental or social condition was in the credit agreement. The 'none' type was not used because the source speaks only about environmental and social covenants, not about every term of the agreement.

nyamagasani-hydro.why: The quotes are on the page: FMO 'is of the view that Frontier has adhered to the Environmental and Social Action Plan developed by FMO for the project', FMO monitored resettlement, displacement and compensation with its adviser Multiconsult, and the review names Performance Standards 1, 4 and 5. But nothing on the page says the US$39 million facility depended on the action plan, and the entry itself admitted the facility agreement terms were not seen. An action plan the lender wrote and watched is not, on this page, a condition of the money.

thilawa-sez-resettlement.why: The quotes are on the page, but they are JICA's general guidelines, which apply to all its projects: 'Appropriate participation by affected people and their communities must be promoted', 'Prior compensation, at full replacement cost, must be provided as much as possible', 'resettlement action plans must be prepared and made available to the public'. The report dates the guidelines to April 2010, not to a loan condition. The resettlement work plan being 'finalized on 22 November 2013' and JICA sending experts to monitor it are facts about what happened, not terms the money depended on, and the entry itself said JICA's input on compensation and wells was advice.

nagdhunga-tunnel-water.changed: Dropped the Category B sentence and the 16,636 million yen figure. Fixed the date the monitoring reports started covering water use.
nagdhunga-tunnel-water.why: The Minutes of Discussions agreement is on the page and is a term agreed with the lender for this project, so the safeguard type stands. The Category B sentence is JICA's general classification policy. The 16,636 million yen loan figure does not appear on the page that was opened. The report says there is 'no description of "water regime and water use" up to the third quarter of 2021' and that the data 'first appears in the monitoring report for the second quarter of 2023'; the entry had read this as coverage starting in the third quarter of 2021.

buchanan-renewables-liberia.changed: Replaced the why quote, which had an ellipsis in it, with a continuous phrase from conditions_add. conditions_add and ct unchanged.
buchanan-renewables-liberia.why: The page carries each part: the Environmental Handbook 'published in February 2004' and 'in effect for both the original and expansion loans'; the company 'voluntarily agreed to comply with relevant International Finance Corporation (IFC) Performance Standards' and 'OPIC incorporated contract conditions that made reference to the Performance Standards', 'at which point they became enforceable for the expansion loan'; and the December 2008 requirements - 'OPIC required BRF to report baseline environmental conditions for those properties', 'required that a Harvest Operations Plan be prepared for each site', 'Required annual Harvest Management Plans including site specific environmental baseline data'. These are contract conditions, so the safeguard type stands.

san-bartolome-potosi.changed: Moved the date of OPIC's question from June 2007 to July 2007 and described the 15-page document as the review does.
san-bartolome-potosi.why: The eight plans, the April 2005 deadline, the December 2004 contract of insurance incorporating 'all the required plans, but one', the quoted clearance wording and the missing Indigenous Peoples provision are all on the page. The page says 'In July 2007, OPIC asked the Project whether a Resettlement Action Plan had been prepared', after the June site visit, and that the project 'provided a 15-page summary of its compensation calculation methodology'. Plans written into the insurance contract are conditions of the cover, so the safeguard type stands.

mozambique-lng-afungi.changed: Replaced 'DFC's 2017 policy states' with a plainer attribution to the report, and quoted the grievance mechanism and reinsurance wording as the pages write them. Also updated the tied why quote to match the reworded sentence.
mozambique-lng-afungi.why: Every EXIM quote is on the press release, including the US content requirement, so safeguard and tied both stand. The DFC report says the $1.5 billion approval 'was contingent on the DFC reinsuring at least $1billion' and that 'DFC never executed a PRI contract'. On the Performance Standards the report says OPIC 'adopted and applied, and that projects must meet, the IFC Performance Standards'; it does not describe this as a 2017 policy, so that label was removed.

san-roque-dam-agno.why: The page lists the four preconditions in these words: 'To confirm the number of relocatees in the reservoir area and secure the consent from them', 'To conduct consultations with any other project affected peoples than relocatees (including the Indigenous Peoples) and surveys to confirm the number of the affected people', 'To secure remedies for all affected people (including the proper consideration for the Indigenous Peoples)' and 'To establish monitoring system for the environmental and social issues'. It also says the proponents 'have not satisfied those preconditions' and that the financing 'has been disbursed entirely as of January 2005'. Preconditions on the loan are conditions, so the safeguard type stands. The one weakness is that this is a campaign group's case paper, not JBIC's own loan document.

kotopanjang-dam.why: The evaluation carries the phrase 'the Indonesian commitment to pay sufficient attention to social and environmental impacts' and says 'the EIA, RKL, and RPL were approved by the Central Environmental Committee of the Government of Indonesia in 1989'. It has no covenant text. The entry claims no condition and leaves ct empty, which matches the page.

ramu-nickel-basamuk.why: The record gives the 23 July 2008 commitment of US$560 million, a 10-year maturity, 'LIBOR (3.119%) plus a 1.6% margin', an RMB rate of 'approximately 4.7%', repayment by 2017 eight years after commissioning, China Metallurgical Group as EPC contractor, and no collateral, guarantee, conditions or tied procurement. ct is empty, which matches.

hambantota-port-zone-clashes.changed: Removed the repay type and reworded two sentences.
hambantota-port-zone-clashes.why: All the figures are on the AidData record: $306,726,736, 6-month LIBOR plus 0.9 percent, the fixed 6.3 percent after restructuring, 15-year maturity, 4-year grace period, 0.3 percent management and commitment fees, the 6 percent Sinosure premium in two instalments, the 1 percent penalty rate, and the 2017 transfer of repayment to the General Treasury. But these are the loan's pricing and repayment schedule, not something the lender required the government to do. The repay type rested on the quote 'China Eximbank lent to the Government of Sri Lanka, which passed the money on to the Sri Lanka Ports Authority', which describes on-lending, not repayment security; the record states no collateral and no sovereign guarantee. 'states no' was also softened to 'does not record', because the page is silent rather than explicit.

peshawar-brt-traders-underpasses.changed: Removed the claim that the government must ensure the design minimizes land acquisition, and quoted the advance-contracting rule as the page words it. Also updated the safeguard why quote to match the reworded sentence.
peshawar-brt-traders-underpasses.why: The page gives Category A for environment and for involuntary resettlement, the quoted resettlement and livelihood restoration plan wording, 'will follow the EIA and environmental management plan', the uploading of the draft and approved final plans, the $97 million cap and 'The issuance of invitations to bid under advance contracting and retroactive financing will be subject to ADB approval'. The sentence on minimizing land acquisition is the page describing the design, not an obligation placed on the government, so it was dropped. The safeguard type rests on the resettlement and livelihood restoration plan wording, which is on the page.

balakot-hydropower-demolitions.changed: Dropped the opening sentence about the Safeguard Policy Statement and the closing quote from the ADB project team, and changed the why quote.
balakot-hydropower-demolitions.why: Each resettlement plan requirement is on the page at the paragraphs cited: prior notice, 'sufficient time (6 months) after the payment of compensation and allowance', 'obtaining an independent valuation by a third-party expert as required by LARP', 'residents of Mouza Bela Sacha to be hired and provided with training and access to credit/loan' and 'an income and livelihood program'. The Safeguard Policy Statement sentence is bank-wide policy, so it cannot carry the safeguard type; the why quote was moved onto the plan requirements. 'There should be no physical displacement unless the affected people are fully paid' is the project team's view reported to the Panel, not a term of the loan.

lapsiphedi-substation-tamang.changed: Dropped the opening sentence about the Safeguard Policy Statement. Also updated the safeguard why quote to match the reworded sentence.
lapsiphedi-substation-tamang.why: The report gives Category A for involuntary resettlement for the 2017 project and Category B for the 2011 project, the resettlement plans 'requiring compensation payment prior to physical or economic displacement', the environmental management plan that 'was required to be part of the bidding documents and contracts for works', and NEA's account that 'the acquired land is legally transferred to the NEA before civil works can commence'. The Safeguard Policy Statement sentence is bank-wide policy and was removed; the safeguard type rests on the compensation-before-displacement requirement, which is on the page.

corridor-vc-mostar-south-malo-polje.changed: Moved the note about EBRD pages not opening out of conditions_add and into searched.
corridor-vc-mostar-south-malo-polje.why: The Early Warning System mirror of the EBRD record carries 'a sovereign-guaranteed loan of up to EUR 180 million to the Motorways of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina', Tranche 1 'up to EUR 120 million', Tranche 2 'up to EUR 60 million' and a Bank Risk Rating of 'A'. A sovereign guarantee is repayment security, so the repay type stands. The page shows only an ESIA link and no action plan, so nothing was claimed about one. Weak point: this rests on a third-party mirror, because ebrd.com would not open.

ruta-del-cacao-santander.why: The page does carry Category A and the quoted wording, but it describes due diligence that 'will confirm the project E&S categorization and assess the project with respect to the client requirements in IDB Invest Environmental and Social Sustainability Policy', with gaps 'addressed in the Environmental and Social Action Plan (ESAP) presented below'. That is the lender's standard review process, written before the fact, and the page does not say the financing depended on the action plan. The listed files are documents the client produced, not requirements. The MICI compliance review documents, which might show real conditions, could not be fetched.

costa-rica-cantonal-roads-buenos-aires.why: The project page gives operation '4507/OC-CR', lending type 'Sovereign Guaranteed', total cost 'USD 152,036,000.00', country counterpart financing 'USD 8,000,000.00' and 'Category B: Likely to cause mostly local and short-term negative environmental and associated social impacts' for which 'effective mitigation measures are readily available', plus management framework and plan files dated 15 December 2017. A sovereign guarantee is repayment security, so the repay type stands.

wadelai-irrigation-paten.changed: Changed the safeguard why quote from the plan's budget to the staff the government had to recruit.
wadelai-irrigation-paten.why: The appraisal report's conditions precedent to first disbursement include the special account, the 'Letter of Comfort stating that the land where the project infrastructure is to be constructed are free of encumbrances and belongs to the communities and/or government who have consented to project activities' and the letter confirming the steering committee 'is in existence'. Other conditions require an M&E Officer, Procurement Officer, 'Environment and Social Development Officer, and an Agri-business Development Officer' within six months of first disbursement. Environment Category 2 and 'an ESMP, with a budgetary allocation of USD 850,000' are on the page, and so is 'It is anticipated that all Project activities will not lead to land acquisition'. The land type stands on the letter of comfort. The safeguard why quote was moved onto the officer the government had to recruit, because a plan's budget on its own is not a condition.
